prompt: Set the estimate to 5 on all the overdue high-priority issues assigned to Maya Chen on the Web team.

references.name: the overdue issue to estimate
references.description: every record the plural request selects (3)

mutation.note: open-state filter replaced by its completed/canceled complement

claims.explanation: It has a past due date, but it is Done, so it is completed and not overdue.
claims.alternative: a completed issue with a past due date

claims.explanation: It is open and matches everything else, but it is due today, so its due date has not passed.
claims.alternative: due today, the nearest date on the wrong side of the cutoff

mutation.note: past-due cutoff replaced by future due

claims.explanation: It is open and matches everything else, but its due date is in the future.
claims.alternative: an open issue with a future due date

references.scope: All records in the supplied environment visible to the actor.

write_check.graphql: mutation { issueUpdate(id: "i-web-1", input: {estimate: 5}) { issue { id estimate } } }
